All 14 queries ran against the data files and gave sensible answers. I checked X3 and X8 by hand. X9, X10, X11 and X14 need `qlang --raw '<query>' < file`, because those files are plain text. The other file-based tasks run as `qlang '<query>' < file.json`.

Results are keyed by keywords such as `:apple`. Where a task asks for string keys or values, I converted them with `toString`.

X1: ["Apple","banana","apple","Cherry","BANANA","date","cherry","apple"] | map ~(lower) | groupBy | map ~(count) | filter ~(gt 1)
X2: get /data/users | filter ~(allOf (query /active | eq true) (query /address/country | ne null)) | map ~(get /address/country | upper) | distinct | sort
X3: filter ~(get /status | lower | eq "paid") | map ~(get {:v ~(get /items | map ~(mulOf /qty /price) | sum) :d ~(coalesce /discount 0)} | subOf /v /d) | sum | round 2
X4: filter ~(get /status | lower | eq "paid") | groupBy /customer | map ~(map ~(get /items | map ~(mulOf /qty /price) | sum) | sum) | entries | map ~(get {:customer ~(get /0 | toString) :total ~(get /1 | round 2)}) | sort ~(get [~(get /total | desc) /customer]) | take 3
X5: get [/dependencies /devDependencies] | map ~(entries) | flat | filter ~(get /1 | startsWith "^") | map ~(get /0 | toString) | distinct | sort
X6: get {:dependencies ~(query /dependencies {} | count) :devDependencies ~(query /devDependencies {} | count) :peerDependencies ~(query /peerDependencies {} | count) :optionalDependencies ~(query /optionalDependencies {} | count)}
X7: filter ~(get /state | eq "open") | groupBy ~(coalesce ~(get /assignee/login | lower) "unassigned") | map ~(count)
X8: filter ~(allOf (get /state | eq "open") ~(get /labels | map ~(get /name | lower) | contains "bug")) | sort ~(get [~(get /comments | desc) /number]) | take 3 | map ~(get /number | toString) | join ","
X9: lines | map ~(trim) | filter ~(ne "") | map ~(split " ") | groupBy /2 | map ~(map ~(get /5 | match #"(\d+)ms" | get /1 | toNumber) | avg | round 1)
X10: lines | map ~(trim) | filter ~(ne "") | map ~(split " ") | filter ~(get /4 | toNumber | gte 500) | map ~(get /3 | split "?" | first) | distinct | sort
X11: lines | drop 1 | map ~(trim) | filter ~(ne "") | map ~(split ",") | filter ~(allOf (get /4 | eq "up") (get /2 | ne "")) | groupBy ~(get /1 | lower) | map ~(map ~(get /2 | toNumber) | avg | round 1)
X12: :d (get /defaults/features) | get /environments | map ~(:f (query /features {} | filter ~(ne null)) | d | merge f | filter ~(eq true) | keys | map ~(toString) | sort)
X13: filter ~(query /salary | ne null) | groupBy /dept | entries | map ~(get {:dept ~(get /0 | toString) :avg ~(get /1 | map /salary | avg | round) :count ~(get /1 | count)}) | sort ~(get [~(get /avg | desc) /dept])
X14: :p (lines | map ~(trim) | filter ~(allOf (ne "") ~(startsWith "#" | eq false)) | map ~(match #"^([^=]+)=(.*)$" | drop 1 | map ~(replace #"^([\"'])(.*)\1$" "$2")) ) | p | get {:db ~(filter ~(get /0 | startsWith "DB_") | map ~(get [~(get /0 | drop 3 | lower | toKeyword) /1]) | toMap) :debug ~(filter ~(get /0 | eq "APP_DEBUG") | map ~(get /1 | lower | anyOf (eq "true") (eq "1") (eq "yes")) | contains true)}
